verdict.rationale: The pack shows OCI has IAM policies, identity domains, and token-based CLI authentication. None of it documents a pattern for giving an agent temporary, narrowly-scoped credentials that it cannot escalate. These are general IAM building blocks and adjacent features, not the story's capability, so they earn no credit. The Select AI agent-team permission grant is a database-schema run permission, not a scoped credential pattern.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, agents get their own leash — documented patterns for handing an agent temporary, narrowly-scoped credentials it cannot escalate
